notes: Read the 50-line source file line by line before editing and preserved the ChartBrushProps API, dataKey default of time, startIndex/endIndex passthrough, height default of 28, and onChange range callback shape.

Replaced the Recharts Brush import with React Native Pressable/View/AppText primitives, preserving the web brush token values for stroke, fill, traveller width, and height without importing DOM modules, Recharts, Leaflet, or web UI components.

The web-only Recharts requirement that Brush be mounted inside a chart for drag/sync wiring is unavailable in native chart containers, so this port renders an explicit native range preview and documents the unavailable drag/sync behavior while tapping emits the current range.
